meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复程序崩溃、卡死与行为异常,让软件恢复稳定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常遇到程序崩溃、卡死或诡异行为却不知如何排查
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix crashes, hangs, and odd behaviors in your software
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get crashes, freezes, or weird errors and want to fix them

howto.what: 遇到程序出错时，它先列出至少三个可能原因并同时排查，不靠猜；两轮失败后换角度再查。找到根因后，先写一个会失败的测试，再做最小修复，最后实际运行验证并清理调试产物。
howto.when: 当你进行任何语言或二进制的真实运行时调试时触发。比如说出“debug this”“why is X not working”“hanging”等，或遇到程序崩溃、静默失败等问题。

say.text: 程序崩溃了，帮我查一下为什么。
say.note: Claude 会先列至少三个假设再动手。

say.text: 这个测试偶尔失败，帮我复现并修复。
say.note: Claude 会按间歇性失败流程排查。

say.text: 接口返回 200 但内容是空的，怎么回事？
say.note: Claude 会检查运行时状态而非只读代码。

howto.what_en: For any runtime bug, Claude forms ≥3 hypotheses and investigates in parallel; after 2 failed rounds it spawns Oracles. It confirms the root cause, writes a failing test, fixes minimally, runs the system to verify, and scrubs artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are debugging any real runtime issue across languages or binaries — e.g., saying “debug this”, “why is X not working”, “hanging”, or facing a crash or silent failure.

say_en.text: My program crashes — can you find out why?
say_en.note: Forms ≥3 hypotheses and investigates in parallel.

say_en.text: This test fails intermittently; help me reproduce and fix it.
HTTP 200 but empty response — what's wrong?
say_en.note: Checks runtime state instead of only reading code.
